name: Cybercore
what_it_means: Cybercore is a nostalgic, hacker-flavoured internet aesthetic: terminal windows, ASCII art, glitchy RGB-split text, wireframe globes, binary rain, pop-ups and acid-green on black. It celebrates raw digital culture and the feeling of being 'jacked in' to the web.
signature_moves: Terminal / command-line windows and monospace → Acid green, cyan and magenta on black
OS pop-ups, loading bars, cursor blinks
best_for: Developer tools, hackathons, security, music & digital art
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a hackathon landing page for [EVENT] in Cybercore style. Pure black background (#050505) with faint scanlines and a dim green grid. Main content inside terminal windows with title bars ('root@cyber:~$'), monospaced text (JetBrains Mono / VT323) in acid green #39FF14, blinking cursor. Headline uses RGB-split glitch (text-shadow 3px 0 #FF00E5, -3px 0 #00F0FF). Add an ASCII-art logo, a rotating wireframe globe, a fake loading bar, binary rain columns and a warning pop-up. Hover = glitch jitter animation.
